title: Battle of Fort Sanders
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fort Sanders", at revision 1370440948, opens: "The Battle of Fort Sanders was the crucial engagement of the Knoxville campaign of the American Civil War, fought in Knoxville, Tennessee, on November 29, 1863. Assaults by Confederate Lt. Gen. James Longstreet failed to break through the defensive lines of Union Maj. Gen. Ambrose Burnside, resulting in lopsided casualties, and the Siege of Knoxville entered its final days." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2672202, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 battle of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
